image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a vertical traffic light mounted against a light-colored building facade. The traffic light housing is dark gray/black with three circular signal lenses stacked vertically. The top lens appears red (though dim/unlit), the middle amber, and the bottom green/clear but heavily damaged or dirty. Each lens has a prominent protruding visor/hood. The background shows architectural details of a building with windows and cornices.
